scope: Test pricing launchers only. No production guard code, defaults, protection or deadlines changed. No performance result or full readiness claim.
changes: Request STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW/SW_HIDE at both pricing launch sites, including the recording launcher child; prepare settings before existing timing starts.
Preserve inherited error-mode bits and verify 0x8003 through the existing process-local helper. No global OS setting changes.
Preserve creation flags, argv, environment, working directory, streams, process hierarchy and deadlines.
Record the requested visibility policy; validate values and reject mixed legacy/new or differing policies within each priced probe, while retaining arbitrary-field rejection.
measurement_limits: Initial visibility is a changed launch context. Old captures are retained without relabelling or pooling into new-context prices.
Legacy-only absent policy remains unspecified. A recorded platform constrains present policy values; without one, only the two exact producer values are accepted.
Outer and nested creation flags remain distinct; hiding does not establish equal console allocation or a pure one-owner cost.
Metadata fixtures observe visibility at one point. They do not prove continuous visibility monitoring or suppression of arbitrary application dialogs.

validation.qualification_method: Components from attempt3 (28 tests and 2 native metadata fixtures) plus corrected synthetic controls from attempt4 on identical source pins. Attempt3 overall FAIL remains unchanged; tests and native fixtures were not repeated in attempt4.

retained_failed_attempts.outcome: Checker used Windows path separators as dictionary keys; stopped before loading tests or fixtures.
New producer field was absent from the strict schema. Corrected without weakening unknown-field checks. DETACHED stream metadata was unavailable and was not counted as coverage.
Portable synthetic control incorrectly labelled Windows resolver paths as Linux. Corrected using owner-only records to isolate visibility validation; original overall failure retained.
